svg.title: LittleSwitch — Overview, Claude, and Codex in the macOS menu bar
svg.desc: Illustrative mockups based on the LittleSwitch interface. Overview connects Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode and shows request activity and token history. Claude maps each route to a provider and model. Codex selects a default model and a separate model for custom approval review. Usage figures are sample data.
